verdict: Plain nasi lemak wins by a little. Protein and fat are the same, but calories are slightly lower and the bungkus (wrapped) portion is more controlled.
why: Plain nasi lemak is about 400 kcal, a plate of mee hoon goreng is about 450 kcal.
Protein is the same, about 12 g each. Fat is also the same, about 17 g.
Nasi lemak bungkus comes in a fixed size. Mee hoon goreng at stalls is sometimes scooped generously, so calories can go higher.
Mee hoon goreng usually has little vegetables and protein, so you may feel hungry again sooner.
when_a: Nasi lemak bungkus suits you when you want a quick breakfast and want to roughly know how much you're eating.
when_b: Mee hoon goreng is okay when you ask for half a plate or add a fried egg and vegetables.
tip: If you take mee hoon goreng, scoop half your usual amount and add a boiled egg or fried egg. Portion is controlled and protein goes up.

faq.q: Is mee hoon lighter than rice?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Mee hoon goreng is cooked with oil, so its calories can be the same as or higher than nasi lemak.

faq.q: How do I cut the calories in nasi lemak?
faq.a: Take just enough sambal, don't add extra peanuts, and drink plain water or teh o kurang manis (plain tea, less sweet).
